create_dino_pretraining_config: create a DINO XCiT pretraining config with mixed precision, GPU count, and number of epochs
create_dino_linear_eval_config: create a DINO XCiT linear evaluation config from a checkpoint path and GPU count
run_config: run a VISSL integration test config and return the training losses
test_pretraining_and_evaluation: test DINO XCiT pretraining with mixed precision followed by linear evaluation on synthetic data
test_dino_xcit_prehemption: test DINO XCiT preemption by removing checkpoints and verifying deterministic recovery
